name: ttu-android
description: Capacitor wrapper that loads the hosted TTu PWA. Build steps in android/README.md

scripts.setup: mkdir -p www && cp ../public/offline.html www/index.html && npx cap add android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#14b8a6' --assetPath ../public/icons
scripts.apk:debug: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
